title: Logic Analyzer Software — Overview and definition
t: Logic Analyzer Software — Overview and definition
description: Captures and decodes digital buses with protocol-aware triggering.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Captures and decodes digital buses with protocol-aware triggering. Logic analyzer software samples digital channels at high rates, triggers on patterns and protocol events, and decodes I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, and USB transactions into readable packets. Real implementations include Saleae Logic, Digilent WaveForms, and sigrok/PulseView for open hardware. It correlates analog and digital views and exports decoded transactions for driver debugging.

title: Logic Analyzer Software — Actual implementation
description: Captures and decodes digital buses with protocol-aware triggering.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. How Logic Analyzer Software is actually implemented. Logic analyzer software samples digital channels at high rates, triggers on patterns and protocol events, and decodes I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, and USB transactions into readable packets. Real implementations combine Desktop GUI, automation API (sockets/Python), CLI capture with USB logic-analyzer hardware or VCD input, decoder libraries. The implementation is verified by Verify by capturing a known I2C EEPROM read at 400 kHz: every address and data byte decodes correctly with ACK/NACK flags matching the bus

title: Logic Analyzer Software — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Captures and decodes digital buses with protocol-aware triggering.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Logic Analyzer Software, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Multi-channel digital capture with pattern and edge triggering). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Multi-channel digital capture with pattern and edge triggering and Protocol decoders: I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, 1-Wire, USB. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Oscilloscope control and analysis program) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
